name: Chrome
author: E. T. Carter
description: A full-frame sheet of liquid chrome rolling in slow swells. A domain-warped height field shaded as a true mirror: a studio with a hard horizon, a near-black floor and a stack of sharp strip lights is reflected in every crest and fold, so the surface reads as polished metal with dark valleys and hot specular ridges rather than a soft grey wash. Palette tints the lights and the body of the metal.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: How fast the metal rolls and folds; 0 freezes the surface.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Height of the swells; low is a near-flat sheet showing the horizon, high tilts the reflections hard into the strip lights.

params.label: Ripple
params.effect: Domain-warp folding of the surface; low is broad rolling swells, high is tight ferrofluid ridges.

params.label: Gloss
params.effect: Sharpness of the reflected light bands and speculars; low is a satin brushed finish, high is a hard mirror.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pushes a bulge into the metal; 0 ignores the mouse.
